---
id: fixture-03
title: Taking a process sample in an H2S-classified area
---
| # | Step | Hazards | Controls |
|---|------|---------|----------|
| 1 | Review the sampling procedure | Wrong sample point chosen | Procedure and P&ID reviewed with the control room |
| 2 | Walk to the sample point | Slips and trips on wet deck | Use walkways; housekeeping checked |
| 3 | Open the sample valve and fill the bottle | Release of sour gas; liquid splash | Valve opened slowly; face shield and chemical gloves |
| 4 | Close the valve and carry the bottle to the lab | Leaking bottle; dropped bottle | Cap checked before leaving; bottle carried in a carrier |
